key_notes: Key 1 (t=5.5s): Initial archival pose of lighter; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=6.62s): Mid-sequence articulation of lighter; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=7.86s): Peak dynamic extension of lighter over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=9.1s): Follow-through and settle of lighter with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of lighter (5.5s..9.1s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
